hooks.command: p=$(cat); case $p in *'"command"'*push* | *'"command"'*pr[[:space:]\\]*create* | *'"command"'*pr[[:space:]\\]*new*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; root="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; [ -n "$root" ] || root=$(unset $(git rev-parse --local-env-vars 2>/dev/null); git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; f="$root/.agents/scripts/guard.ts"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; printf '%s' "$p" | node "$f" tool-start
